engine: Standalone single-thread Cell CPU; Apple M3 Max; rustc 1.94.0; Cargo --release --locked; view-ports and the original frozen 64-unit schedule.
method: One process per measurement. Width 0/1/8 in rotated order; reversed on alternate three-round cycles. 9 rounds on sum-bits, 6 on Raytrace. No other experiment or compilation from this task ran during timings. Audit files and per-Run index/wake tracking are separate. Timed arms do not use D3 ports, training traces or measured rule IDs.

ranked_rules.source:
(rule ((Add-Gets orig (Single e) n))
      ((union (Get orig n) e))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((Get tup i)
       (ContextOf tup ctx))
      ((ContextOf (Get tup i) ctx))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((= lhs (Get _tup _i))
       (ExprIsResolved _tup))
      ((ExprIsResolved lhs))
        :ruleset is-resolved )

(rule ((= lhs (Get e @_6))
       (HasArgType e ty))
      ((HasArgType lhs ty))
        :ruleset type-analysis )

(rule ((Get _tup _i)
       (ExprIsPure _tup))
      ((ExprIsPure (Get _tup _i)))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((Concat x y)
       (ContextOf x ctx))
      ((ContextOf (Concat x y) ctx))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((Concat x y)
       (ContextOf y ctx))
      ((ContextOf (Concat x y) ctx))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((Bop op x y)
       (ContextOf x ctx))
      ((ContextOf (Bop op x y) ctx))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((Bop op x y)
       (ContextOf y ctx))
      ((ContextOf (Bop op x y) ctx))
        :ruleset always-run )
(rewrite (AddContext ctx (Single c1)) (Single (AddContext ctx c1)) :ruleset context)

(rule ((= lhs (Concat e1 e2))
       (HasArgType e1 ty))
      ((HasArgType lhs ty))
        :ruleset type-analysis )

(rule ((If pred inputs then else)
       (ContextOf pred ctx))
      ((ContextOf (If pred inputs then else) ctx))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((= lhs (Bop @_1 a b))
       (HasArgType a ty))
      ((HasArgType lhs ty))
        :ruleset type-analysis )

(rule ((= lhs (Bop @_2 a b))
       (HasArgType b ty))
      ((HasArgType lhs ty))
        :ruleset type-analysis )
(rewrite (AddContext ctx (Concat c1 c2)) (Concat (AddContext ctx c1) (AddContext ctx c2)) :ruleset context)
(rewrite (Bop (Add ) (Bop (Sub ) x y) z) (Bop (Add ) x (Bop (Sub ) z y)) :ruleset peepholes)
(rewrite (AddContext ctx (Get c1 index)) (Get (AddContext ctx c1) index) :ruleset context)

(rule ((Top op x y z)

      ((ContextOf (Top op x y z) ctx))

(rule ((Top op x y z)

(rule ((= lhs (Concat e1 e2))

(rule ((BodyContainsExpr body (Single _x)))

        :ruleset always-run )

        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((Bop _op _x _y)
       (BinaryOpIsPure _op)
       (ExprIsPure _x)
       (ExprIsPure _y))
      ((ExprIsPure (Bop _op _x _y)))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((= lhs (Bop _op _x _y))
       (ExprIsResolved _x)
       (ExprIsResolved _y))
      ((ExprIsResolved lhs))
        :ruleset is-resolved )

(rule ((Call func arg)
       (ContextOf arg ctx))
      ((ContextOf (Call func arg) ctx))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((= lhs (Bop @_2 a b))
       (HasArgType b ty))
      ((HasArgType lhs ty))
        :ruleset type-analysis )

(rule ((= lhs (DoWhile inp pred-body))
       (HasType inp (TupleT tylist)))
      ((HasArgType pred-body (TupleT tylist)))
        :ruleset type-analysis )

(rule ((DoWhile in pred-and-output)
       (ContextOf in ctx))
      ((ContextOf (DoWhile in pred-and-output) ctx))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((= lhs (Bop @_1 a b))
       (HasArgType a ty))

(rewrite (AddContext ctx (Bop op c1 c2)) (Bop op (AddContext ctx c1) (AddContext ctx c2)) :ruleset context)
(rewrite (AddContext ctx (Concat c1 c2)) (Concat (AddContext ctx c1) (AddContext ctx c2)) :ruleset context)

(rule ((Bop (PtrAdd ) e i)
       (= (lo-bound i) (IntB lo))
       (> lo 0))
      ((NoAlias e (Bop (PtrAdd ) e i)))
        :ruleset mem-simple )
(rewrite (Concat (Concat a b) c) (Concat a (Concat b c)) :ruleset always-run)

(rule ((Top _op _x _y _z)
       (TernaryOpIsPure _op)
       (ExprIsPure _x)
       (ExprIsPure _y)
       (ExprIsPure _z))
      ((ExprIsPure (Top _op _x _y _z)))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((= lhs (Top _op _x _y _z))
       (ExprIsResolved _x)
       (ExprIsResolved _y)
       (ExprIsResolved _z))
      ((ExprIsResolved lhs))
        :ruleset is-resolved )

(rule ((= lhs (Top @_3 a b c))
       (HasArgType a ty))
      ((HasArgType lhs ty))
        :ruleset type-analysis )

(rule ((BodyContainsExpr body (Get _tup _i)))
      ((BodyContainsExpr body _tup))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((BodyContainsExpr body (Single _x)))
      ((BodyContainsExpr body _x))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((BodyContainsExpr body (Bop _op _x _y)))
      ((BodyContainsExpr body _x)
       (BodyContainsExpr body _y))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((= lhs (Bop op e1 e2))
       (bop-of-type op ty)
       (HasType e1 ty)
       (HasType e2 ty))
      ((HasType lhs ty))
        :ruleset type-analysis )

(rule ((BodyContainsExpr body expr)
       (= loop (DoWhile in body))
       (= expr (Single _x))
       (is-inv-Expr body _x))
      ((is-inv-Expr body expr))
        :ruleset always-run )

(rule ((= lhs (If pred inputs then else))
       (HasType pred (Base (BoolT )))
       (HasType then ty)
       (HasType else ty))
      ((HasType lhs ty))
        :ruleset type-analysis )
